title: Because of
subtitle: 因為，究竟是哪一種「由於」？

falseSynonyms.zh: 儘管不等於因為 despite 表示讓步關係，即使有某情況仍發生另一件事；不是原因關係。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The match continued despite the rain. The match was cancelled because of the rain.

falseSynonyms.zh: 雖然不等於因為 although 引出讓步子句，不是原因。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Although it was raining, we went out. Because it was raining, we stayed inside.

falseSynonyms.zh: 所以不等於因為 therefore 表示結果，方向和 because of 相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The road was flooded; therefore, it was closed. It was closed because of the flooding.

falseSynonyms.zh: 所以不等於因為 so 通常引出結果；because of 引出原因。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON It was late, so we left. We left because of the time.

falseSynonyms.zh: 片語與連接詞結構不同 because of 後接名詞片語；because 後接完整子句。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We stayed home because of the rain. We stayed home because it was raining.

falseSynonyms.zh: 結構不同 due 單獨可表示預定、應付或到期；表示原因時通常需要 due to。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The train is due at six. The delay was due to bad weather.

falseSynonyms.zh: 原因這個名詞不等於原因連接語 reason 是名詞；不能直接像 because of 一樣連接原因。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The reason was bad weather. The event was cancelled because of bad weather.

falseSynonyms.zh: 原因本身不等於因為 cause 是名詞或動詞，表示原因或造成；because of 是介詞片語。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The cause was flooding. The road closed because of flooding.
